frame_contract.title: CAN DATA DIE?
frame_contract.governing_system: A seeded ring buffer launches colored grid cells from the pointer; velocity and alpha decay make data appear, travel and die.

chars.counting_rule: UTF-8 decoded characters in the authored runtime index.html; excludes shared chassis, research notes, tests and screenshots

decision: The original full sample was already compact, conventionally formatted and clearly below 10k. The 11-character net increase buys symmetric listener ownership plus error-free static-title fallbacks; further reduction would make the deterministic model less learnable or delete visual behavior.
changes: Centralized pointer, keyboard and pagehide ownership under one AbortController so teardown cannot drift from registration.
Used the stable field ID directly and removed four manual listener-removal paths without changing event type, order or options.
Guarded missing chassis and Canvas 2D contexts so the semantic title remains as an error-free static fallback.
Retained descriptive configuration, seeded random generation, ring-buffer update, title attenuation and public inspection state in readable form.

tests.name: fixed-state pixel and model equivalence
tests.evidence: A controlled requestAnimationFrame queue produced equal ring/emission state, logical Canvas hashes and paired screenshots.

tests.name: deterministic reset
tests.evidence: Independent reset paths reproduced all 75 velocity pairs and the exact initial Canvas hash while incrementing generation.

tests.name: pointer, touch and reduced motion
tests.evidence: Mouse movement and real touch pointerdown moved the launch origin and evolved the same baseline/candidate pixels; reduced motion ignored pointer changes and kept the representative still stable.

tests.name: resize and lifecycle
tests.evidence: Live 1280x720 resize retained one 1600x900 logical Canvas and viewport-equal scroll bounds; pagehide stopped the loop, resize observer and all listeners, made subsequent inputs inert, and reload restored one clean generation.

tests.name: selfcheck and runtime
tests.evidence: No clipping, escaped content, overlap, failed resource, page error or console error was found.

cross_audit.scope: Independent generative-reference audit of formal immutability, author metrics, seeded ring-buffer algorithm, title exclusion field, two viewports, normal/reduced states, pointer/touch/reset, resize, fallback, pagehide disposal and reload.
cross_audit.revision: Added missing-Deck and missing-Canvas guards. Unsupported rendering now preserves the semantic title and themed field without console errors; seeded generation, ring updates and the normal draw loop are untouched.

mini_decision.reason: The improved full is clearly below 10k and already exposes the complete learnable algorithm; a second mini would duplicate maintenance without meaningful token savings.

cross_audit.assessment: pass; fallback robustness improved without visual, animation, interaction, seed, algorithm or lifecycle degradation

rejected_changes.change: shorten particle fields, configuration or state into positional tuples
rejected_changes.reason: would save little while making the governing system harder for an Agent to learn

rejected_changes.change: reduce the particle ring, grid density, title attenuation or update path
rejected_changes.reason: would lower the cover's visual or conceptual quality

rejected_changes.change: replace the live Canvas with a captured representative frame
rejected_changes.reason: would remove the real seeded generation, pointer response, decay and reset logic
